id: title:andrewm4894:propose crowded area contributors before returning no reviewers

review.posthog_relevance: Adds crowd fallback assignment to the reviewer selection path, potentially assigning contributors when no specific blame candidate or area ownership is identified, though this is not a PostHog production path.
review.reason: Adds an optional parameter to the reviewer assignment and scoring functions, including the caller, while retaining original behavior. This could prevent reports from remaining unrouted in a specific edge case. However, the implementation and relevant checks are not visible in the supplied observations, and the connection to PostHog is not established.
review.uncertainty: The supplied observations do not establish a connection to PostHog, and the implementation and relevant checks are not visible. The tier is assigned based on the observed behavior, not the connection to PostHog.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are independently verified. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional parameter allow_crowd_fallback to resolve_suggested_reviewers, rank_assignee_candidates, _rank_scored_candidates, and _score_candidates, and its callers, while retaining the original behavior when the parameter is False.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter controls whether the reviewer path, when no blame candidate exists and no area implies ownership, proposes crowd contributors instead of returning an empty list. This prevents reports from remaining unrouted when the agent path also returns nothing.

observations.behavior: Updates docstrings and comments to clarify that crowd fallback is only used when no blame candidate exists and no area implies ownership, and that it does not cancel claims earned in a focused area.
observations.code_quote: # The blame author is past the window, so only the crowded area keeps the stranger out —
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies test expectations: crowd fallback does not apply when a blame candidate exists, preserving the original behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test case that explicitly checks the crowd fallback behavior when allow_crowd_fallback is True and False, and another test case that checks the behavior when no blame candidate exists and no area implies ownership.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for the crowd fallback behavior, including the case where no blame candidate exists and no area implies ownership, and the case where the agent path also returns nothing.
